Definition: Non-neuronal cells per neuron in primary auditory cortex (A1; the densely myelinated field, outlined on a light box). Not printed in the paper: derived by the merge as the mean number of non-neuronal cells divided by the mean number of neurons. It is a ratio of group means, the same whether computed from the measured one-hemisphere numbers or from their doubled estimates, and it need not equal the ratio implied by the printed percentage of neurons. Measured in one hemisphere (dissected from the hemisphere that was not kept intact); never doubled. Monodelphis domestica, group mean of 5 adults, isotropic fractionator (Seelke, Dooley & Krubitzer 2014, Table 4).
Note: measured in one hemisphere; not an extensive value, never doubled
Source Note: written for the 2026-11-23 wiring; values, units and doubling in cell_counts_isotropic_fractionator_compiled.R sec 1.7, 3.4n and 3.5
